description: The path of a Swiss parliamentary item (Geschäft) that reached a National Council final vote in the current legislature: title, type, responsible department, submission date, topics, the dated status history (submitted, in committee, planned, final vote, done), the debate days in each chamber with number of speeches and speaking time and the link to the Official Bulletin, the final vote result and, where it went to the people, the popular vote. Find it by business number (e.g. 26.033) or by words of the title.
name: parliament_business
